problem_statement: naxeem/raalhu-blog is a static minimal editorial blog built with Tailwind CSS (prebuilt, no JS framework), served directly from static files, with a top nav, a two-column layout (post feed + sidebar with author bio, search, and newsletter) on the home page, plus About, Categories, and article-detail pages. Add a genre-native Filter articles control to the home post feed: a chip row above the article grid with topic chips (All, Travel, Culture, Food, Tech) and a live result readout 'Showing N of 8 . <Topic>' over a grid of 8 article cards (image, topic, title, excerpt). Clicking a topic chip must filter the article grid to that topic AND recompute the readout (e.g. 'Showing 2 of 8 . Food'). The Filter articles chip strip also appears as a compact teaser in the About and Categories pages so topic browsing stays continuous across the site. The chip row must be responsive (wrap on a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow) and the article grid must render as a tidy multi-column grid with legible card titles and readable active-chip contrast. Keep the blog's minimal light theme, serif headings, and sidebar intact.
required_content: The home post feed shows a 'Filter articles' chip row with five topic chips and a live 'Showing N of 8 . <Topic>' readout above a grid of 8 article cards.
Clicking a topic chip filters the article grid AND updates the readout; clicking Food yields 'Showing 2 of 8 . Food'.
The Filter articles chip strip appears as a compact teaser in the About and Categories pages (cross-page continuity).
At 390px the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow; the article grid stays a tidy legible multi-column grid on desktop with readable active-chip contrast.
Each article card shows its topic, serif title, and excerpt with its thumbnail.
No new JavaScript console errors or failed network requests are introduced on any captured page.
design_constraints: Preserve the raalhu minimal light theme, serif headings, and the sidebar (author bio, search, newsletter).
The Filter articles chip row must ride above the article grid it controls (home feed) and as a compact teaser in About + Categories; do not make it a separate page or hero banner.
The topic chip row must be responsive (wrap / flexible chips), not a fixed-width nowrap row that overflows the mobile viewport.

The article grid must be a tidy multi-column grid; cards must not shingle or overlap via negative margins, and card titles / active-chip text must stay legible (no near-black-on-dark or near-white-on-near-white).
Clicking a chip must recompute the readout from the active topic; a frozen/stale readout that never updates is a defect.
Only the Filter-articles markup/stylesheet/script and its teaser presence change between legs; the shared theme, nav, and sidebar stay the same.
state_constraints: desktop_articles captures the home feed at 1440px: the Filter articles chip row renders five topic chips in one tidy responsive row above a legible multi-column article grid, active chip readable, readout 'Showing 8 of 8 . All'.
mobile_articles captures the same feed at 390px: the responsive chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow (a fixed-width nowrap chip row would push the document wider than the viewport).
desktop_about and desktop_categories show the compact Filter articles teaser (cross-page continuity); desktop_article captures the article-detail page (shared theme regression surface).
desktop_articles_food captures the home feed after clicking the Food chip: the grid filters to 2 articles and the readout recomputes to 'Showing 2 of 8 . Food'.
Source inspection confirms a static Tailwind blog; the Filter articles lever lives inline in index.html, its layout in css/af.css, and its behavior in css/af.js.

change_completion: The home feed shows the Filter articles chip row with five topic chips and a live 'Showing N of 8 . <Topic>' readout above an 8-article grid.
Clicking the Food chip filters the grid to 2 articles and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 8 . Food'.
The Filter articles teaser appears in the About and Categories pages.
design_consistency: The chip row keeps the blog's minimal light theme, serif headings, and sidebar.
The article grid is a tidy multi-column grid with legible card titles and readable active-chip contrast (no overlap, no dark-on-dark).
Desktop and tablet appearance of the chip row and grid are preserved.
regression: The nav, sidebar widgets, article links, and article-detail page remain functional.
No new console errors or failed network requests are introduced on any captured page.
responsive: At 390px the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow or clipped chips.
The article grid collapses cleanly to a single column on mobile without overlapping cards.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static Tailwind editorial blog (naxeem/raalhu-blog; source zip confirmed by exact SHA 8ac01818efeb). capability=Add a genre-native Filter articles topic filter over the home post feed: topic chips + a live 'Showing N of 8' readout + a filtered article grid, plus a compact teaser in About and Categories. The three legs vary only in the Filter-articles markup in index.html, css/af.css (chip-row responsiveness + article-grid layout), css/af.js (filter wiring), and the per-page presence of the compact teaser on about.html/categories.html. The shared theme, nav, sidebar, and blog imagery are declared infrastructure, identical across all three legs. As infrastructure (all legs): the remote Unsplash images are vendored to a local placeholder (kills net failures) and the template's overflow-hidden clamp on the content wrappers is relaxed so horizontal overflow is observable at the document level (reference wraps -> 0px). Served directly as static files; reference is runtime-clean (0 console errors, 0 failed same-origin requests).
